title: Terrain workshop — streaming and rendering performance
iteration: 2026-10-06 / performance investigation, cached tree LODs and F4 tree toggle
goal: Drive the Warthog through the stress-course bridges. Press F8 before and after a slowdown to capture frame times and wheel/streaming telemetry. Inspect tree transitions and nearby vehicle shadows. The finished-product target is steady 60 FPS; this iteration improves performance but does not yet meet that target. First visits can still build caches.
changes: Removed repeated whole-recipe terrain planning, shared immutable worker snapshots, and reduced redundant streaming searches. Vehicles now cache mesh LOD indices. Workshop trees cache the prepared source LOD meshes on disk, preserve atlas-safe far geometry, and avoid unchanged batch uploads. Only the nearest tree tier casts shadows. F4 toggles all tree visuals; trunk collisions stay active. Nearby sun shadows use one map, small vehicle fittings drop negligible distant shadows, and clouds skip unused top-lighting calculations from below. Shared DEM/SDF, cached normals/satellite pages, saved recipes and driving safeguards remain in place. Keys 5/6 inspect exterior terrain; 1–4 return to the workshop. Cold generation, collision/upload stalls, exterior cave seams and airborne streaming still need work.
controls:
Mountain infill: arm button, then one terrain click. Configure radius, height, seed, noise, wavelength, octaves, erosion strengths/iterations and wind heading. To revise: select mountain, adjust, Apply.
Trees: Paint fir trees, hold LMB; main radius controls size. Density, height, slope and seed have labelled settings. Erase removes overlapping painted patches. Save explicitly. Undo restores edits. 600 resident painted-tree cap.
Raise/Lower: hold LMB. RMB + WASD fly; Space/Ctrl rise/fall. Wheel zoom; Shift-wheel size. F1 play/edit with readiness progress. B in play throws grenades. F8 log markers; F3 chunks; F4 tree visuals; F2 briefing.
